thread:
priya: follow-up on the quota bridge roll-forward strategy. aiming for minimal customer impact and robust anti-evasion.
oton: top constraints: no customer-visible billing regressions, clear rollback, low SDK churn.
priya: agreed. approach: keep LeaseAPI authoritative for the initial window. introduce a transparent bridge shim that forwards requests to the new ledger and tags them with X-Quota-Bridge header so ingress can dedupe.
nate: how does dedupe work in practice? need pseudocode for ingress.
priya: simple flow:
```
if req.headers['X-Quota-Bridge']:
  if seen(req.id): return 202_NO_CHARGE
  mark_seen(req.id)
  forward_to_ledger()
else:
  forward_to_legacy()
```
oton: partial-failure case concerns me: legacy success + ledger timeout => potential undercharging if ledger write eventually fails.
priya: mitigation: legacy is source-of-truth during migration; ledger writes are best-effort and write-retries queued. nightly reconcilers will compare ledgers and surface mismatches.
nate: what thresholds trigger pager? and can we run recon more frequently for high-volume tenants?
priya: initial cadence: nightly; pager if mismatch >0.15% sustained 24h. we can auto-escalate to hourly for tenants above a traffic threshold.
ots-bot: scheduled canary: prod-canary-small on 2024-11-20T07:00Z. watchers: @eng-infra, @oncall.
deploy-bot: canary started: build r2024.11.20-bridge. logs: https://deploys/redwood/canary/4987654321
oton: abuse detection: clients switching endpoints to circumvent rate limits. solution: cross-path fingerprint counter in ingress (HyperLogLog sketch) keyed by client-fingerprint + time-window. if cross-path QPS > 3x rolling baseline AND burst credits disabled => route to probation and alert.
priya: ledger will optionally return X-Quota-Abuse:score header. ingress uses score>60 to drop to probation pool.
nate: SDK updates?
priya: optional. headers are exposed but SDKs don't need mandatory changes. console will surface abuse metrics per customer.
oton: rollback plan if reconciliation shows >1% undercharging: flip shim to pass-through (shim.mode=legacy-only), pause-ledger-ingest, and revert any customer-facing flags. playbook steps and runbook snippet will be added.
priya: thanks all. I'll update the RFC with the header formats, dedupe metric (dedupe_rate), reconciliation SLOs, and the canary observability checklist. ping here with canary metrics so we can watch dedupe_rate and cross_path_abuse trends. :eyes:
